sources.summary:
If you haven’t chosen how to bill Copilot code review for members with a Copilot license, those reviews will be billed to your organization starting December 30, 2026. To keep…
If you haven’t chosen how to bill Copilot code review for members with a Copilot license, those reviews will be billed to your organization starting December 30, 2026. To keep billing unchanged, select Member before then. This change applies to organizations and enterprises with Copilot Business or Copilot Enterprise.
Tod
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Copilot code review计费若未选择，2026年12月30日起将有许可证成员的评审费默认计入拥有仓库的组织；想保持不变需提前选Member。

en.reason: Copilot code review charges for licensed members will default to the organization starting December 30, 2026, affecting Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise organizations and enterprises, which must select Member before then to keep billing unchanged.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2 采访17位科学家，归纳出 validation、privacy 等五个科研信任维度，讨论 AI agents 接手文献综述和数据分析时，科学家需核查证据、理解方法并保护隐私。

en.reason: Ai2 interviewed 17 scientists to define five trust dimensions, including validation and privacy, for AI agents handling literature reviews and data analysis, stressing that researchers must still check for overlooked conflicting evidence, understand which methods and files an agent used, and protect privacy.

sources.title_en: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.title_original: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 用 CUGA 做 Indic 语音代理，让农民用 Hindi、Tamil 等母语问如何辨别种子好坏；文中指出默认英文 embedding 会取错段落，改用 intfloat/multilingual-e5-large 后一份英文文档可服务多语言。

en.reason: IBM Research built a CUGA-based Indic voice agent that lets farmers ask in Hindi, Tamil and other languages how to tell good seeds from bad, and switching from default English embeddings to intfloat/multilingual-e5-large lets one English document serve multiple languages.

en.title: OpenAI and Anthropic internally discuss "pausing training": frontier models too powerful to release, as employees fear safety risks are spiraling out of control
